follow-up time: 15 days for vaginal delivery, 21 days for cesarean delivery
study type: true experimental design with pre-and post-test control group design
cohort: The study included 100 postpartum mothers, with 50 in the experimental group receiving Mezile's model and 50 in the control group receiving back massage training only.
finding: The study found that Mezile's model (back massage and self-hypnosis) was effective in reducing anxiety levels in postpartum mothers compared to back massage training alone.
